content.title: Special Event Permit
content.summary: A Special Event Permit is required for events in the City of Woodinville involving more than 30 people in public parks, private parties exceeding building occupancy, or events impacting public facilities or requiring city services. The permit process includes application submission, review, payment, and permit issuance.
content.eligibility: Events hosted within the City of Woodinville that include private parties exceeding building occupancy, gatherings of more than 30 people in City parks, sale or trading of merchandise or services on City park land, or events on Woodinville Sports Fields involving large tents or additional facilities.

steps.title: Complete and submit your Special Event Permit Application
steps.text: Complete the Special Event Application form in full, including a proposed site map showing placement of tents, food trucks, stage, etc., a proposed route map with turn-by-turn details, a Certificate of Liability, a proposed parking plan, and a proposed signage plan. Submit the application using the online Permit Portal or by completing a paper form.

steps.title: Application Review
steps.text: Your completed application will be routed for review to the Permit Center technicians.

steps.title: Payment and Permit Issuance
steps.text: Once the permit receives final approval, you will be contacted to log in to your online Permit Portal account, pay the associated invoice, and print the permit and approved stamped plans. The permit and approved plans must be available onsite the day of the event.

fees.name: Permit Review and City Services
fees.notes: Fees for permit review and city services such as traffic and crowd control, street sweeping, or use of equipment will be assessed prior to the event.

faqs.q: When is a Special Event Permit required?
faqs.a: A Special Event Permit is required for events with more than 30 people in City parks, private parties exceeding building occupancy, events impacting public facilities, or events requiring city services.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a Special Event Permit?
faqs.a: You can apply online through the Permit Portal or submit a paper form. The application must be complete with all required documents and plans.

faqs.q: Who can I contact for help with my application?
faqs.a: Permit Technicians can be reached by emailing permits@woodinvillewa.gov or by calling 425-489-2754.
